_about: Public-domain William Berriman (1688-1750), London rector and Boyle lecturer, for the Word Hoard: An Historical Account of the Trinitarian Controversy (Lady Moyer Lectures, 1725), The Gradual Revelation of the Gospel (Boyle Lectures, 2 vols., 1733), Christian Doctrines and Duties in forty sermons (2 vols., 1751), and his single sermons and tracts against Whiston and Chandler. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 87 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
